rules.step2: Nail the QTE. Every card you play is gone for good.
rules.step3: Own the aura bar when the moves run out.

tutorial.title: FIRST TIME
tutorial.sweep: The cursor crosses the bar. Tap it inside a green zone — once per pass. Amber still scores, but it costs you a flawless run.
tutorial.lanes: Notes fall down the lanes. Tap a lane the moment its note reaches the line. Tapping a lane with nothing in it costs you a note.
tutorial.mash: Tap the pads as fast as you can. With more than one, walk them in order — never the same pad twice in a row.
tutorial.order: The numbers are scattered. Press them in order, 1 first. A wrong number costs you.
tutorial.zone: Put a finger on the ring and keep it there. It drifts. You are scored on how much of the card you stayed inside.
tutorial.paths: A thumb on each wheel. The lanes scroll and wander — keep both thumbs inside their own lane.

glossary.judgementText: How cleanly you hit the gesture. A MISS costs you aura.
glossary.freshMoveText: You answered with a different kind of gesture than the last one played.
glossary.hardMoveText: A HARD card pays a bonus on top of a bigger base, so landing one is worth about half again a NORMAL. It is also the one you are most likely to drop, and a dropped card pays nothing at all.
glossary.streakText: PERFECTs in a row, yours only. Each link is worth more than the last; anything short of a PERFECT breaks it.
glossary.outauraText: Your play was worth half again what the rival's last one was. Pays a bonus on top.
glossary.freshText: A different kind than the last move. Pays a bonus and feeds momentum.
glossary.neutralText: Same kind, different card. No bonus, and momentum slips.
glossary.staleText: The very same card again. No bonus, and momentum drops hard.
glossary.meterText: Fills on PERFECTs and GOODs, on varying your answers, on hard cards, and on streaks. Repeating yourself drains it.
glossary.godAuraText: A full meter sets you alight and doubles everything you score. A MISS puts it out.
glossary.barText: One bar between you. Every point you score pushes it their way. Push it all the way over and the battle is yours on the spot.
glossary.moggedText: The bar reached their end. The battle stops there, whatever is left in the decks.
glossary.lostComposureText: You ran out of time choosing. The turn is spent and your momentum is wiped — but your cards are all still yours.
glossary.outOfMovesText: Both of you have taken every turn. Whoever holds the bar wins.
